description: Find recent news articles about a topic, newest first: title, url, publisher, published_at, language and a short snippet where the publisher gives one. Reads GDELT's worldwide article list (published_at is the time GDELT first saw the article; no snippet) and open-licence publisher feeds (Global Voices, NASA; with snippet and author). Costs 1 credit per source read, at most 2. A source that fails is named in data.errors while the other still answers. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code, such as en, fr, es or vi (18 supported; the feeds cover en, fr and es).

q.description: The words to find, such as "electric cars"; every word must appear.

timespan.description: Optional window back from now, 1h to 90d, such as 24h or 3d (default 7d).

name: data_search_news
title: Search recent news articles
